start.content: I drew the sword when the guards came for Him in Gethsemane. I struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear. I was ready for a fight. He was not.

why_attack.content: I thought this was the moment to defend Him. We had seen the crowd, the threats, the plotting. I believed force was the only language left.

jesus_response.content: He told me to put the sword away. Then He touched Malchus and healed the ear I had severed. In the middle of an arrest, He chose mercy over violence.

not_the_way.content: Yes. He said those who live by the sword die by the sword. I wanted to protect Him with steel, but He submitted to the Father's will and stopped the bloodshed.

closing.content: No rebellion. No insurrection. Only betrayal, fear, and a King who healed His enemy while being led away.
